rules.name: Rune of Destruction
rules.description: Multiple Wounds (D3).

rules.name: Rune of Smashing
rules.description: Attacks allocated towards a model with Resilience 5 or more have both their Strength and their Armour Penetration set to 10.

rules.name: Rune of Penetration
rules.description: +3 AP.

rules.name: Rune of Might
rules.description: +1 Str, +1 AP.

rules.name: Rune of Precision
rules.description: +1 to hit.

rules.name: Rune of Craftsmanship
rules.description:
The weapon follows the rules for Great Weapon instead of its original Weapon Rules. 
This does not prevent it from being engraved with additional Runic Weapon Enchantments.

rules.name: Rune of Quickening
rules.description: +3 Agi.

rules.name: Rune of Anger
rules.description: +1 Att.

rules.name: Rune of Lightning
rules.description:
Max. 2 per model.
Grind Attack (D3, Str 4, AP 1, Lightning Attacks,Magical Attacks, Unmodifiable). 
A model with two instances of this Rune increases the number of hits to 2D3. 
 Note that these hits are not affected by the effects of other Runic Weapon Enchantments.

rules.name: Rune of Returning
rules.description: Can be used as a Shooting Weapon with the following profile: Range 8", Shots 1, Str , AP , Quick to Fire,Accurate, The effects of other Runic Weapon Enchantments apply to Shooting Attacks made with this weapon (even if their effects were normally restricted to Melee Attacks, including Special Attacks).

rules.name: Rune of Fire
rules.description:
During Combat Choices, the wielder may gain Flaming Attacks. 
 Duration: Round of Combat.

rules.name: Rune of Resistance
rules.description: Resistance.

rules.name: Rune of Steel
rules.description: Must reroll failed Armour Save rolls.

rules.name: Rune of Retribution
rules.description: When a model successfully makes an Aegis Save from Shield Wall, it immediately inflicts 1 hit towards the Health Pool of the model that caused the wound, using the same Strength and Armour Penetration as the saved attack with Automatic Hits. This hit is resolved before any casualties are removed and does not benefit from Weapon Rules or Runic Weapon Enchantments.

rules.name: Rune of Iron
rules.description:
Max. 2 per model.
+1 Arm.

rules.name: Rune of the Forge
rules.description: Aegis (3+, against Flaming Attacks).

rules.name: Rune of Denial
rules.description:
One use only. 
 The player may choose to use this Rune instead of performing a Dispelling Roll. The spell is automatically dispelled.

rules.name: Rune of Devouring
rules.description:
Runic Smiths only
One use only. The player may choose to use this Rune instead of performing a Dispelling Roll. 
 The spell is cast as normal, but the Caster may not cast it again for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Rune of Harnessing
rules.description:
Runic Smiths only
In each of your opponent’s Magic Phases, immediately after Excess Magic, they must discard 1 Magic Dice.

rules.name: Rune of Courage
rules.description: One use only. May be activated during Combat Choices. The bearer gains Stubborn. Duration: Round of Combat.

rules.name: Rune of Dragon's Breath
rules.description: Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 1, Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks).

rules.name: Rune of Grounding
rules.description:
Runic Smiths only
One use only. May be activated during Combat Choices. 
 All spells with Duration: One Turn that affect any of the following units come to an end: 
 • The bearer’s unit. 
 • Enemy units in contact with the bearer’s unit.

rules.name: Rune of Readiness
rules.description:
One use only. May be activated at the end of the Charge Phase, immediately after all Charge Moves have been resolved. 
 If the bearer’s unit was successfully charged during this phase, it may perform a Combat Reform (following the normal rules for Combat Reforms).

rules.name: Rune of Storms
rules.description:
One use only. May be activated at the start of the opponent’s Player Turn. 
 Choose a single enemy unit within 24" of the bearer. 
 The Charge Speed and Mobility of all models with Fly in that unit are halved, rounding fractions up. Duration: End of Turn.

rules.name: Rune of Shielding
rules.description: Aegis (+1, max. 4+), which can only stack with itself and Shield Wall.

rules.name: Rune of Channeling
rules.description:
Channel (1). 
This Rune can only be used if the model’s army total combined value for Channel is 3 or less (excluding Channel from this Rune).

rules.name: Rune of Mining
rules.description:
During Pre-game Selections, choose a Terrain Feature on the Battlefield. 
As long as the bearer is on the Battlefield, all friendly models may treat this Terrain Feature as Open Terrain when making a Move Manoeuvre (Advance, March, Reform), but must still follow the Unit Spacing rule at the end of their move.

rules.name: Rune of Kinship
rules.description: The bearer gains Ambush (Battlefield Edge), Scout, Vanguard.

rules.name: Runic Standard of Grudges
rules.description: Ancient Grudge (1).

rules.name: Runic Standard of Swiftness
rules.description: The bearer’s unit gains Vanguard.

rules.name: Runic Standard of Dismay
rules.description: Charge Range rolls against the bearer’s unit gain Minimised.

rules.name: Runic Standard of Steadiness
rules.description:
One use only. May be activated at the start of any Movement Phase. 
 The bearer’s unit loses Unwieldy. Duration: End of Turn.

rules.name: Runic Standard of the Anvil
rules.description: Whenever a friendly unit Charges an enemy unit already Engaged in Combat with the bearer’s unit and fails its Charge Range roll, it must reroll that roll.

rules.name: Runic Standard of Wisdom
rules.description:
Select a single Battle Rune and write it on your Army List. 
 This Battle Rune can be cast by the bearer as a Bound Spell. 
 It can only target the bearer’s own unit.

rules.name: Rune of Revocation
rules.description:
Ignore all other spell effects on the target from spells with Duration: One Turn. 
 The target unit gains
 Magic Resistance (2), which is also applied to friendly spells.

No model can be affected by more than one instance of the same Battle Rune Bound Spell simultaneously.

rules.name: Rune of Reckoning
rules.description:
Friendly models in the target unit gain Hatred. 
 Melee Attacks by friendly models towards the target unit benefits from Hatred.

No model can be affected by more than one instance of the same Battle Rune simultaneously.

rules.name: Rune of Oaths
rules.description:
Friendly models in the target unit gain Zeal. 
 Melee Attacks by friendly models towards the target unit benefits from Zeal.

No model can be affected by more than one instance of the same Battle Rune simultaneously.

rules.name: Rune of Resolve
rules.description:
The target gains Swiftstride and, until the end of the Player Turn, it also gains Light Troops. 
In addition, the target may immediately perform a Magical Move (4 Mob).

No model can be affected by more than one instance of the same Battle Rune simultaneously.

rules.name: Rune of Gleaming
rules.description:
The target gains Distracting (1),Hard Target (1).

No model can be affected by more than one instance of the same Battle Rune simultaneously.

rules.name: Rune of Resilience
rules.description:
To-wound rolls against the target suffer a -1 modifier.

No model can be affected by more than one instance of the same Battle Rune simultaneously.

rules.name: Runic Standard of the Hold
rules.description:
All models in the bearer’s unit gain Resolute.
 If the unit contains a model that already has Resolute from another source, the unit is considered to have two additional Proper Ranks instead of one.

sharedRules.name: Monster Seeker
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Multiple Wounds (2, towards Height 3--5). 
 In addition, when a unit containing this rule Charges a unit containing a model with Height 3-5, its Charge Range roll gains Maximised.

sharedRules.name: Grim Resolve
sharedRules.description:
The model gains +1 Att for each enemy model in contact with it. 
 In addition, when a unit containing this rule Charges a unit containing a model with Height 0-2, its Charge Range roll gains Maximised.

sharedRules.name: Rune Craft Mastery
sharedRules.description: Melee Attacks from models in a unit containing Rune Craft Mastery gain +1 AP.

sharedRules.name: Entrench
sharedRules.description: All friendly Field Artillery units within 6" of a model with Entrench benefit from Hard Target (1).

sharedRules.name: Runic Anvil
sharedRules.description:
The model must select three different Battle Runes. Note which spells are selected on the Army List. 
 The Range of these spells is set to 36". 
 The model cannot cast Bound Spells in the same Player Turn that it performed a Move Manoeuvre.

sharedRules.name: Kingsoath
sharedRules.description:
The model part gains +1 Att. 
 The extra Melee Attack resulting from Kingsoath can only be allocated towards targets in a unit containing a Grudge Marker.

sharedRules.name: Crag Warden
sharedRules.description: The model gains Hard Target (1), Light Troops,Skirmisher.

sharedRules.name: Brothers of Vengeance
sharedRules.description: The model gains Hard Target (1), Light Troops, Skirmisher, Vanguard.

sharedRules.name: Whirling Chains of Doom
sharedRules.description: The wielder gains +1D3 Grind Attacks when engaged with an enemy unit containing a Grudge Marker

sharedRules.name: Runic Engravings (Vanguard)
sharedRules.description: +3 Agi, Vanguard

sharedRules.name: Shrapnel Grenades
sharedRules.description:
One use only. Duration: One Phase.
 Can be activated in the Movement Phase: when activated, the model gains Sweeping Attack (D3, Str 3, AP 1).

sharedRules.name: Shrapnel Bombs
sharedRules.description: The model gains Sweeping Attack (2D6, Str 3, AP 1).

sharedRules.name: Flaming Shot
sharedRules.description: The model’s Shooting Attacks become Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks.

sharedRules.name: Rune Crafted
sharedRules.description: The model’s Shooting Weapon gains Magical Attacks and the effects within brackets.

sharedRules.name: Hewn Out of Mountains
sharedRules.description: The player of this army has a +1 modifier on Dispel Rolls, as long as at least one friendly model with Channel (X) is on the Battlefield.

sharedRules.name: Ancient Grudge
sharedRules.description:
During Pre-game Selections, a Dwarven Holds army marks units on the opponent’s Army List with Grudge Markers (note that Characters can be marked, too). 
The number of Grudge Markers placed is equal to the number of instances of Ancient Grudge on units in your Army List.
 All model parts with Dwarf in your army gain First Strike (Hatred (towards units containing a Grudge Marker)).

sharedRules.name: Shield Wall
sharedRules.description: Models of Height 1--3 using a Hand Weapon and a Shield simultaneously gain Aegis (6+, against Melee Attacks from models Engaged in their Front Facing), as well as Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks from Charging models Engaged in their Front Facing).

sharedRules.name: Runic Weapon Enchantments
sharedRules.description:
Runic Weapon Enchantments follow the rules for Weapon Enchantments, with the following differences: 
 • All Runic Weapon Enchantments are enchantments for Hand Weapons and Paired Weapons. 
 • Up to three Runic Weapon Enchantments can be applied to a single weapon. 
 • Each combination of Runic Weapon Enchantments is Legendary. 
 • Multiple instances of the same Runic Weapon Enchantment are cumulative, unless mentioned otherwise. 
 • When noting Runes on the Army List, use the following format: Runic Weapon (Rune A, Rune B, Rune C).
